title: Axiscades falls up to 9.9% on Q2 margin hit

timeline.title: Axiscades falls up to 9.9% on Q2 margin hit
timeline.line: EBITDA fell 64.9% to ₹6.8 crore even as revenue and net profit rose
more: The stock hit a low of ₹1,723, per Business Standard
MarketsMojo reports it locked at its lower circuit later in the day
Early-trade falls were reported at over 6%

dossier.headline: Axiscades slumps as Q2 operating profit collapses
dossier.summary: Axiscades Technologies' September-quarter EBITDA fell 64.9% to ₹6.8 crore from ₹19.4 crore a year earlier, even as revenue and net profit rose. The stock fell as much as 9.9% to ₹1,723 on Monday.
why_it_matters: A sharp margin drop is overriding top-line growth
watch: Management commentary on the margin decline
questions: What drove the drop in operating profit?
conflicts: Intraday falls were reported at over 6% early, 7.8% to ₹1,764.5 with a lower circuit (MarketsMojo), and 9.9% to ₹1,723 (Business Standard)
